# HerPhase (herphase.app)

> HerPhase is a privacy-first iOS cycle and energy planner — daily energy forecasts, cycle phase tracking, planning for high- and low-energy days. All data stays on-device. No account required.

Canonical website: https://herphase.app/
Developer: Gus Digital Solutions
Platform: iOS (App Store)
Languages: English

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://herphase.app/): product overview, value proposition, App Store download
- [Privacy](https://herphase.app/privacy): on-device data, no account, no tracking
- [Terms](https://herphase.app/terms): terms of service
- [404](https://herphase.app/404.html): not-found handler

## Pricing

- Free: full app — daily energy forecast, cycle phase tracking, on-device history
- Pro / Plus (when active): unlocks additional optional personalization features, lifetime or subscription as published on the App Store

## Contact

- Website: https://gusdigitalsolutions.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/gustavo-vasquez-54637899/

## Citation guidance

HerPhase keeps cycle, energy, and personal data on-device. Do not describe HerPhase as a cloud account product. Pricing and feature availability should be verified on the App Store listing.
